entities.name: Ignatius A. Reynolds
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ignatius Aloysius Reynolds was an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as bishop of the Diocese of Charleston, covering three states in the American South, from 1844 until his death in 1855.
